data.gender_notes: Leobardo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Leo meaning lion and bard meaning brave, so Leobardo means Brave Lion. The name Leobardo carries the meaning “Brave Lion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Leobardo usually hope their child will grow to embody brave lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Leobardo represents inner strength and courage. It reminds us to face our fears and challenges with bravery and determination.
data.etymology: Leobardo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leobardo total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: ליאובארדו
in_hebrew.meaning: ליאובארדו - האיש האלוהי, דבקותו של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ליאובארדו הוא שם משיחי שמקורו במילים הגרמניות 'ליוב' ו'הארד', שמשמעותם 'איש אלוהי' ו'חזק' או 'אמיץ'. השם משקף את הדבקותו של אלוהים ואת החוזק הרוחני. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים, במיוחד במסורת הגרמנית והלטינית.

in_greek.name: Λεοβάρδο
in_greek.meaning: Λεοβάρδο - Ο Λέων τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἡ θεία ἀφοσίωσις
in_greek.long_meaning: Λεοβάρδο εἶναι ὄνομα Χριστιανικό, προερχόμενο ἀπὸ τὰ Γερμανικὰ λέξεις 'Λίوب' καὶ 'Χαρτ', σηματοδοτοῦν 'Θεῖος ἄνθρωπος' καὶ 'ἰσχυρός' ἢ 'andreios'. Τὸ ὄνομα αὐτὸ ἐκφράζει τὴν ἀφοσίωσιν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν πνευματικὴν ἰσχύν. Εἶναι σὲ χρήση μεταξὺ Χριστιανῶν, ἐπὶ τῆς ἰστορίας τῆς Γερμανικῆς καὶ Λατινικῆς παραδόσεως.

in_latin.name: Leobardo
in_latin.long_meaning: Leobardo est nomen Christianum, ortum ex Germanicis vocibus 'Liub' et 'Hard', quae significant 'homo Dei' et 'fortis' seu 'audax'. Nomen hoc devotionem Dei et spiritualem fortitudinem exprimit. In usu est apud Christianos, praesertim in traditione Germanica et Latina.

in_english.name: Leobardo
in_english.meaning: Leobardo - A devoted man of God, strong in faith
in_english.long_meaning: Leobardo is a Christian name derived from Germanic roots 'Liub' and 'Hard', meaning 'beloved' and 'brave' or 'strong'. It signifies a devoted person of God, reflecting spiritual strength and faith. Historically used in Germanic and Latin traditions, the name Leobardo conveys a sense of divine dedication and courage, resonating with Christian values of devotion and resilience.

He was a monk and bishop, and played a significant role in the Council of Toledo (589 AD) which established the Spanish church organization. Leobardo was later elected bishop of León in 591 AD.

Leobardo, a Benedictine monk born in the 11th century AD in León, Spain.
